local RefreshHomePage

local DBRuntimeState = {
    MainStatus = "运行中",
    Scripts = {},
    ScriptOrder = {}
}

------------------------------------------------------------
-- DB 紧急关停：客户端基线 / 回滚 / 会话重建
------------------------------------------------------------
local function DBGetGuiRoots()
    local roots = {}
    local seen = {}

    local function addRoot(root)
        if root
        and typeof(root) == "Instance"
        and not seen[root] then
            seen[root] = true
            roots[#roots + 1] = root
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        addRoot(
            LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild(
                "PlayerGui"
            )
        )
    end)

    pcall(function()
        addRoot(
            game:GetService(
                "CoreGui"
            )
        )
    end)

    pcall(function()
        if type(gethui) == "function" then
            addRoot(
                gethui()
            )
        end
    end)

    return roots
end

local function DBCaptureGuiBaseline()
    local baseline = {}

    for _, root in ipairs(
        DBGetGuiRoots()
    ) do
        local ok, children =
            pcall(function()
                return root:GetChildren()
            end)

        if ok and children then
            for _, child in ipairs(
                children
            ) do
                baseline[child] = true
            end
        end
    end

    return baseline
end

local function DBCollectNewTopLevelGui(
    baseline
)
    local result = {}
    local seen = {}

    baseline =
        baseline
        or {}

    for _, root in ipairs(
        DBGetGuiRoots()
    ) do
        local ok, children =
            pcall(function()
                return root:GetChildren()
            end)

        if ok and children then
            for _, child in ipairs(
                children
            ) do
                if child ~= MainGui
                and not baseline[child]
                and not seen[child] then
                    local shouldTrack =
                        child:IsA("LayerCollector")
                        or child:IsA("Folder")

                    if shouldTrack then
                        seen[child] = true
                        result[#result + 1] =
                            child
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return result
end

local function DBDestroyInstances(list)
    local destroyed = 0

    if type(list) ~= "table" then
        return destroyed
    end

    for _, object in ipairs(list) do
        if typeof(object) == "Instance"
        and object.Parent then
            local ok =
                pcall(function()
                    object:Destroy()
                end)

            if ok then
                destroyed =
                    destroyed + 1
            end
        end
    end

    return destroyed
end

local function DBCaptureClientSnapshot()
    local snapshot = {}

    pcall(function()
        snapshot.Gravity =
            workspace.Gravity
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local camera =
            workspace.CurrentCamera

        if camera then
            snapshot.Camera = {
                FieldOfView =
                    camera.FieldOfView,
                CameraType =
                    camera.CameraType,
                CameraSubject =
                    camera.CameraSubject
            }
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local lighting =
            game:GetService(
                "Lighting"
            )

        snapshot.Lighting = {
            Brightness =
                lighting.Brightness,
            ClockTime =
                lighting.ClockTime,
            FogStart =
                lighting.FogStart,
            FogEnd =
                lighting.FogEnd,
            ExposureCompensation =
                lighting.ExposureCompensation,
            GlobalShadows =
                lighting.GlobalShadows,
            Ambient =
                lighting.Ambient,
            OutdoorAmbient =
                lighting.OutdoorAmbient
        }
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local character =
            LocalPlayer.Character

        local humanoid =
            character
            and character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
                "Humanoid"
            )

        if humanoid then
            snapshot.Humanoid = {
                WalkSpeed =
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed,
                JumpPower =
                    humanoid.JumpPower,
                JumpHeight =
                    humanoid.JumpHeight,
                HipHeight =
                    humanoid.HipHeight,
                AutoRotate =
                    humanoid.AutoRotate,
                PlatformStand =
                    humanoid.PlatformStand,
                Sit =
                    humanoid.Sit,
                UseJumpPower =
                    humanoid.UseJumpPower
            }
        end
    end)

    return snapshot
end

local function DBRestoreClientSnapshot(
    snapshot
)
    if type(snapshot) ~= "table" then
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        if snapshot.Gravity ~= nil then
            workspace.Gravity =
                snapshot.Gravity
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local camera =
            workspace.CurrentCamera

        local saved =
            snapshot.Camera

        if camera
        and type(saved) == "table" then
            if saved.FieldOfView ~= nil then
                camera.FieldOfView =
                    saved.FieldOfView
            end

            if saved.CameraType ~= nil then
                camera.CameraType =
                    saved.CameraType
            end

            if saved.CameraSubject
            and saved.CameraSubject.Parent then
                camera.CameraSubject =
                    saved.CameraSubject
            else
                local character =
                    LocalPlayer.Character

                local humanoid =
                    character
                    and character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
                        "Humanoid"
                    )

                if humanoid then
                    camera.CameraSubject =
                        humanoid
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local lighting =
            game:GetService(
                "Lighting"
            )

        local saved =
            snapshot.Lighting

        if type(saved) == "table" then
            for property, value in pairs(
                saved
            ) do
                pcall(function()
                    lighting[property] =
                        value
                end)
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local character =
            LocalPlayer.Character

        local humanoid =
            character
            and character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
                "Humanoid"
            )

        local saved =
            snapshot.Humanoid

        if humanoid
        and type(saved) == "table" then
            local restoreProperties = {
                "WalkSpeed",
                "JumpPower",
                "JumpHeight",
                "HipHeight",
                "AutoRotate",
                "PlatformStand",
                "Sit",
                "UseJumpPower"
            }

            for _, property in ipairs(
                restoreProperties
            ) do
                if saved[property] ~= nil then
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid[property] =
                            saved[property]
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local DBSessionGuiBaseline =
    DBCaptureGuiBaseline()

local DBSessionClientSnapshot =
    DBCaptureClientSnapshot()

local DBAbsoluteShutdownBusy = false


local function DBSetScriptStatus(name, status)
    name = tostring(name or "未命名脚本")
    status = tostring(status or "未知")

    local info =
        DBRuntimeState.Scripts[name]

    if not info then
        info = {}
        DBRuntimeState.Scripts[name] = info
        table.insert(
            DBRuntimeState.ScriptOrder,
            name
        )
    end

    info.Status = status
    info.UpdatedAt = os.clock()

    if RefreshHomePage then
        pcall(RefreshHomePage)
    end
end

local function DBSetScriptHandle(name, handle)
    name =
        tostring(
            name
            or "未命名脚本"
        )

    local info =
        DBRuntimeState.Scripts[name]

    if not info then
        info = {
            Status = "运行中",
            UpdatedAt = os.clock()
        }

        DBRuntimeState.Scripts[name] =
            info

        table.insert(
            DBRuntimeState.ScriptOrder,
            name
        )
    end

    info.Handle = handle
end

local function DBRememberScriptGui(
    name,
    baseline
)
    name =
        tostring(
            name
            or "未命名脚本"
        )

    local info =
        DBRuntimeState.Scripts[name]

    if not info then
        return
    end

    info.ManagedGui =
        info.ManagedGui
        or {}

    info.ManagedGuiSet =
        info.ManagedGuiSet
        or {}

    local found =
        DBCollectNewTopLevelGui(
            baseline
        )

    for _, object in ipairs(found) do
        if not info.ManagedGuiSet[object] then
            info.ManagedGuiSet[object] =
                true

            info.ManagedGui[#info.ManagedGui + 1] =
                object
        end
    end
end


local function DBTryCleanupHandle(handle)
    if handle == nil then
        return false
    end

    local valueType =
        typeof(handle)

    if valueType == "RBXScriptConnection" then
        local ok =
            pcall(function()
                handle:Disconnect()
            end)

        return ok
    end

    if valueType == "Instance" then
        local ok =
            pcall(function()
                handle:Destroy()
            end)

        return ok
    end

    if type(handle) == "thread" then
        local ok =
            pcall(function()
                task.cancel(handle)
            end)

        return ok
    end

    if type(handle) == "function" then
        local ok =
            pcall(handle)

        return ok
    end

    if type(handle) == "table"
    or valueType == "userdata" then
        local methodNames = {
            "Stop",
            "Shutdown",
            "Unload",
            "Destroy",
            "Disable",
            "Disconnect",
            "Cleanup",
            "Close"
        }

        for _, methodName in ipairs(
            methodNames
        ) do
            local okRead, method =
                pcall(function()
                    return handle[methodName]
                end)

            if okRead
            and type(method) == "function" then
                local okCall =
                    pcall(function()
                        method(handle)
                    end)

                if okCall then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end

        if type(handle) == "table" then
            local cleanedAny = false

            for _, child in pairs(handle) do
                local childType =
                    typeof(child)

                if childType == "RBXScriptConnection"
                or childType == "Instance"
                or type(child) == "thread"
                or type(child) == "function" then
                    if DBTryCleanupHandle(child) then
                        cleanedAny = true
                    end
                end
            end

            return cleanedAny
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function DBStopScriptByName(name)
    name =
        tostring(
            name
            or ""
        )

    local info =
        DBRuntimeState.Scripts[name]

    if not info then
        return false, "未记录"
    end

    -- 第一优先级：先关该脚本被DB追踪到的UI。
    local uiDestroyed =
        DBDestroyInstances(
            info.ManagedGui
        )

    local cleaned =
        DBTryCleanupHandle(
            info.Handle
        )

    info.Status =
        cleaned
        and "已关停"
        or (
            uiDestroyed > 0
            and "UI已关闭 · 主体已请求关停"
            or "已请求关停"
        )

    info.UpdatedAt =
        os.clock()

    if RefreshHomePage then
        pcall(RefreshHomePage)
    end

    return cleaned, info.Status
end

local function DBStopAllTrackedScripts()
    local total = 0
    local cleaned = 0

    for _, name in ipairs(
        DBRuntimeState.ScriptOrder
    ) do
        local info =
            DBRuntimeState.Scripts[name]

        if info
        and (
            info.Status == "运行中"
            or info.Status == "加载中"
        ) then
            total = total + 1

            local ok =
                DBStopScriptByName(name)

            if ok then
                cleaned = cleaned + 1
            end
        end
    end

    return total, cleaned
end


local function DBAbsoluteShutdown()
    if DBAbsoluteShutdownBusy then
        return
    end

    DBAbsoluteShutdownBusy = true
    DBRuntimeState.MainStatus =
        "绝对关停中"

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. 第一优先级：立即关闭 DB UI
    --------------------------------------------------------
    pcall(function()
        MainGui.Enabled = false
    end)

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. 关闭 DB 启动以后出现的新顶层脚本 UI
    --------------------------------------------------------
    local newGui =
        DBCollectNewTopLevelGui(
            DBSessionGuiBaseline
        )

    DBDestroyInstances(
        newGui
    )

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. 尽最大能力停止 DB 已追踪到的所有脚本
    --------------------------------------------------------
    pcall(function()
        DBStopAllTrackedScripts()
    end)

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4. 恢复 DB 启动前记录的客户端本地状态
    --------------------------------------------------------
    pcall(function()
        DBRestoreClientSnapshot(
            DBSessionClientSnapshot
        )
    end)

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5. 最后销毁 DB 自己的 UI
    -- 不传送、不重进、不踢出，继续留在当前服务器。
    --------------------------------------------------------
    pcall(function()
        MainGui:Destroy()
    end)

    DBRuntimeState.MainStatus =
        "已关停"
end


local function DBCloseScript()
    -- 只关闭DB自身及由DB追踪的功能，不做旧“紧急关停”的全局GUI扫描。
    pcall(function()
        DBRuntimeState.MainStatus = "已关闭"
    end)

    pcall(function()
        DBStopAllTrackedScripts()
    end)

    pcall(function()
        DBRestoreClientSnapshot(DBSessionClientSnapshot)
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if playerGui then
            local flightGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("DB_FLIGHT_UI")
            if flightGui then
                flightGui:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        if MainGui and MainGui.Parent then
            MainGui:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end


local function SafeLoadScript(item)
    local itemName =
        tostring(
            item and item.Name
            or "未命名脚本"
        )

    local scriptGuiBaseline =
        DBCaptureGuiBaseline()

    DBSetScriptStatus(
        itemName,
        "加载中"
    )

    task.spawn(function()
        local success, resultOrError =
            pcall(function()
                if item.Code then
                    local chunk =
                        loadstring(
                            item.Code
                        )

                    return chunk()
                elseif item.Url then
                    local src =
                        game:HttpGet(
                            item.Url
                        )

                    local chunk =
                        loadstring(src)

                    return chunk()
                end
            end)

        if success then
            DBSetScriptHandle(
                itemName,
                resultOrError
            )

            DBSetScriptStatus(
                itemName,
                "运行中"
            )

            -- UI有些会延迟创建，因此分两次追踪。
            task.delay(
                0.35,
                function()
                    DBRememberScriptGui(
                        itemName,
                        scriptGuiBaseline
                    )
                end
            )

            task.delay(
                1.60,
                function()
                    DBRememberScriptGui(
                        itemName,
                        scriptGuiBaseline
                    )
                end
            )

            ShowDBNotification(
                "加载成功",
                itemName,
                true
            )
        else
            DBSetScriptStatus(
                itemName,
                "加载失败"
            )

            warn(
                "❌ 脚本加载失败: "
                .. tostring(
                    resultOrError
                )
            )

            ShowDBNotification(
                "加载失败",
                itemName,
                false
            )
        end
    end)
end

local function DBCreateAdvancedPlayerPanel(
    parent
)
    local controller = {}
    local refreshers = {}
    local snapshot = nil

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 玩家面板按钮统一效果：
    -- 默认常亮，不需要点击后才显眼；
    -- 按下缩一下，松开带轻微回弹，和脚本按钮一致。
    --------------------------------------------------------
    local function StylePlayerPanelButton(
        button,
        redMode
    )
        button.TextTransparency = 0
        button.AutoButtonColor = false

        if redMode then
            button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 112, 130)
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 12, 18)
            button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
        else
            button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.84
            button.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            button.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.80
            button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        end

        for _, child in ipairs(button:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("UIGradient") then child:Destroy() end
        end

        local scale = button:FindFirstChild("DB_PlayerPanelClickScale")
        if not scale then
            scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
            scale.Name = "DB_PlayerPanelClickScale"

    local subtitle =

    local function getTargets()
        local player =
            LocalPlayer

        local character =
            player
            and player.Character

        local humanoid =
            character
            and character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
                "Humanoid"
            )

        local root =
            character
            and character:FindFirstChild(
                "HumanoidRootPart"
            )

        local camera =
            workspace.CurrentCamera

        return player,
            character,
            humanoid,
            root,
            camera
    end

    local function safeNumber(value)
        local n =
            tonumber(
                value
            )

        if not n
        or n ~= n
        or n == math.huge
        or n == -math.huge then
            return nil
        end

        return n
    end

    local function formatValue(value)
        if value == nil then
            return "nil"
        end

        if type(value) == "number" then
            return string.format(
                "%.3f",
                value
            ):gsub(
                "0+$",
                ""
            ):gsub(
                "%.$",
                ""
            )
        end

        return tostring(
            value
        )
    end

    local function notify(
        textValue
    )
        ShowDBNotification(
            "玩家面板",
            textValue,
            true
        )
    end

        apply.TextSize = 10
        apply.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        apply.AutoButtonColor = false
        apply.ZIndex = 24
        apply.Parent = row

        AddCorner(
            apply,
            7
        )

        AddDBEnchantedBorder(
            apply,
            0.62,
            true
        )

        StylePlayerPanelButton(
            apply,
            false
        )

        local function refresh()
            local ok,
                value =
                pcall(
                    getter
                )

            if ok then
                box.Text =
                    formatValue(
                        value
                    )
            else
                box.Text = "不可用"
            end
        end

        local function commit()
            local ok,
                err =
                pcall(
                    setter,
                    box.Text
                )

            if ok then
                refresh()
            else
                warn(
                    "[DB玩家面板] "
                    .. labelText
                    .. " 修改失败: "
                    .. tostring(
                        err
                    )
                )
            end
        end

        apply.Activated:Connect(
            commit
        )

        box.FocusLost:Connect(
            function(
                enterPressed
            )
                if enterPressed then
                    commit()
                end
            end
        )

        refreshers[
            #refreshers + 1
        ] = refresh

        return refresh
    end

    local function createNumericProperty(
        section,
        labelText,
        targetGetter,
        propertyName
    )
        createValueEditor(
            section,
            labelText,
            function()
                local target =
                    targetGetter()

                return target
                    and target[
                        propertyName
                    ]
            end,
            function(raw)
                local n =
                    safeNumber(
                        raw
                    )

                if not n then
                    error(
                        "请输入有效数字"
                    )
                end

                local target =
                    targetGetter()

                if not target then
                    error(
                        "目标不存在"
                    )
                end

                target[
                    propertyName
                ] = n
            end
        )
    end

        label.TextXAlignment =
            Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

        label.ZIndex = 24
        label.Parent = row

        local toggle =
            Instance.new(
                "TextButton"
            )

        toggle.Size =
            UDim2.new(
                0.32,
                -5,
                0,
                26
            )

        toggle.Position =
            UDim2.new(
                0.68,
                0,
                0.5,
                -13
            )

        toggle.BackgroundColor3 =
            Color3.fromRGB(
                15,
                22,
                31
            )

        toggle.BackgroundTransparency =
            0.08

        toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
        toggle.TextSize = 10
        toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        toggle.AutoButtonColor = false
        toggle.ZIndex = 24
        toggle.Parent = row

        AddCorner(
            toggle,
            7
        )

        AddDBEnchantedBorder(
            toggle,
            0.62,
            true
        )

        StylePlayerPanelButton(
            toggle,
            false
        )

        local function refresh()
            local target =
                targetGetter()

            if not target then
                toggle.Text = "不可用"
                return
            end

            local ok,
                value =
                pcall(function()
                    return target[
                        propertyName
                    ]
                end)

            if not ok then
                toggle.Text = "不可用"
                return
            end

            toggle.Text =
                value
                and "开启"
                or "关闭"
        end

        toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
            local target =
                targetGetter()

            if not target then
                return
            end

            pcall(function()
                target[
                    propertyName
                ] =
                    not target[
                        propertyName
                    ]
            end)

            refresh()
        end)

        refreshers[
            #refreshers + 1
        ] = refresh

        return refresh
    end

    local function createVectorEditor(
        section,
        labelText,
        getter,
        setter
    )
        local row =
            createRow(
                section,
                62
            )

        local label =
            Instance.new(
                "TextLabel"
            )

        label.Size =
            UDim2.new(
                1,
                -18,
                0,
                22
            )

        label.Position =
            UDim2.fromOffset(
                9,
                2
            )

        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Text = labelText

        label.TextColor3 =
            Color3.fromRGB(
                238,
                241,
                248
            )

        label.TextSize = 10
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium

        label.TextXAlignment =
            Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

        label.ZIndex = 24
        label.Parent = row

        local boxes = {}

        for i,
            axis in ipairs({
                "X",
                "Y",
                "Z"
            }) do
            local box =
                Instance.new(
                    "TextBox"
                )

            box.Size =
                UDim2.new(
                    0.22,
                    -4,
                    0,
                    26
                )

            box.Position =
                UDim2.new(
                    0.02
                    + (
                        i - 1
                    ) * 0.23,
                    0,
                    0,
                    30
                )

            box.BackgroundColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    9,
                    12,
                    18
                )

            box.BackgroundTransparency =
                0.10

            box.BorderSizePixel = 0
            box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
            box.Text = ""
            box.PlaceholderText = axis

            box.TextColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    250,
                    252,
                    255
                )

            box.PlaceholderColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    210,
                    224,
                    240
                )

            box.TextSize = 9
            box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            box.ZIndex = 24
            box.Parent = row

            AddCorner(
                box,
                6
            )

            boxes[
                i
            ] = box
        end

        local apply =
            Instance.new(
                "TextButton"
            )

        apply.Size =
            UDim2.new(
                0.27,
                -6,
                0,
                26
            )

        apply.Position =
            UDim2.new(
                0.72,
                0,
                0,
                30
            )

        apply.BackgroundColor3 =
            Color3.fromRGB(
                15,
                22,
                31
            )

        apply.BackgroundTransparency =
            0.08

        apply.BorderSizePixel = 0
        apply.Text = "应用"
        apply.TextSize = 9
        apply.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        apply.AutoButtonColor = false
        apply.ZIndex = 24
        apply.Parent = row

        AddCorner(
            apply,
            6
        )

        AddDBEnchantedBorder(
            apply,
            0.62,
            true
        )

        StylePlayerPanelButton(
            apply,
            false
        )

        local function refresh()
            local ok,
                value =
                pcall(
                    getter
                )

            if ok
            and typeof(
                value
            ) == "Vector3" then
                boxes[1].Text =
                    formatValue(
                        value.X
                    )

                boxes[2].Text =
                    formatValue(
                        value.Y
                    )

                boxes[3].Text =
                    formatValue(
                        value.Z
                    )
            end
        end

        local function commit()
            local x =
                safeNumber(
                    boxes[1].Text
                )

            local y =
                safeNumber(
                    boxes[2].Text
                )

            local z =
                safeNumber(
                    boxes[3].Text
                )

            if not x
            or not y
            or not z then
                return
            end

            pcall(
                setter,
                Vector3.new(
                    x,
                    y,
                    z
                )
            )

            refresh()
        end

        apply.Activated:Connect(
            commit
        )

        refreshers[
            #refreshers + 1
        ] = refresh
    end

    local function getAttrTarget()
        local player,
            character,
            humanoid =
            getTargets()

        local name =
            attrTargets[
                attrTargetIndex
            ]

        if name == "玩家" then
            return player
        elseif name == "角色" then
            return character
        end

        return humanoid
    end

    local function parseAttributeValue(
        raw
    )
        local lower =
            string.lower(
                raw
            )

        if lower == "true" then
            return true
        elseif lower == "false" then
            return false
        end

        local n =
            safeNumber(
                raw
            )

        if n then
            return n
        end

        return raw
    end

    local function refreshAttrs()
        attrTargetButton.Text =
            attrTargets[
                attrTargetIndex
            ]

        local target =
            getAttrTarget()

        if not target then
            attrList.Text =
                "目标不存在"
            return
        end

        local ok,
            attrs =
            pcall(function()
                return target:GetAttributes()
            end)

        if not ok then
            attrList.Text =
                "无法读取自定义属性"
            return
        end

        local lines = {}

        for name,
            value in pairs(
                attrs
            ) do
            lines[
                #lines + 1
            ] =
                tostring(name)
                .. " = "
                .. tostring(value)
        end

        table.sort(
            lines
        )

        if #lines == 0 then
            attrList.Text =
                "暂无自定义属性"
        else
            attrList.Text =
                table.concat(
                    lines,
                    "\n"
                )
        end
    end

    attrTargetButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        attrTargetIndex =
            attrTargetIndex % #attrTargets
            + 1

        refreshAttrs()
    end)

    setAttr.Activated:Connect(function()
        local target =
            getAttrTarget()

        if not target
        or attrName.Text == "" then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            target:SetAttribute(
                attrName.Text,
                parseAttributeValue(
                    attrValue.Text
                )
            )
        end)

        refreshAttrs()
    end)

    removeAttr.Activated:Connect(function()
        local target =
            getAttrTarget()

        if not target
        or attrName.Text == "" then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            target:SetAttribute(
                attrName.Text,
                nil
            )
        end)

        refreshAttrs()
    end)

    refreshers[
        #refreshers + 1
    ] = refreshAttrs

    local function getObjectPath(
        object,
        root
    )
        local parts = {}
        local current = object

        while current
        and current ~= root do
            table.insert(
                parts,
                1,
                current.Name
            )

            current =
                current.Parent
        end

        return table.concat(
            parts,
            "."
        )
    end

    local function refreshValueRows()
        for _,
            child in ipairs(
                dynamicValuesHost:GetChildren()
            ) do
            if child:IsA(
                "Frame"
            ) then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end

        local player,
            character =
            getTargets()

        local found = {}

        local function scan(
            root,
            prefix
        )
            if not root then
                return
            end

            for _,
                object in ipairs(
                    root:GetDescendants()
                ) do
                if object:IsA(
                    "IntValue"
                )
                or object:IsA(
                    "NumberValue"
                )
                or object:IsA(
                    "BoolValue"
                )
                or object:IsA(
                    "StringValue"
                ) then
                    found[
                        #found + 1
                    ] = {
                        Object = object,
                        Label =
                            prefix
                            .. "."
                            .. getObjectPath(
                                object,
                                root
                            )
                    }

                    if #found >= 40 then
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        scan(
            player,
            "玩家"
        )

        if #found < 40 then
            scan(
                character,
                "角色"
            )
        end

        if #found == 0 then
            local empty =
                Instance.new(
                    "TextLabel"
                )

            empty.Size =
                UDim2.new(
                    1,
                    0,
                    0,
                    28
                )

            empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            empty.Text =
                "当前没有可见的数值对象数据"

            empty.TextColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    220,
                    232,
                    248
                )

            empty.TextSize = 9
            empty.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            empty.ZIndex = 23
            empty.Parent =
                dynamicValuesHost

            return
        end

        for index,
            info in ipairs(
                found
            ) do
            local object =
                info.Object

            local row =
                createRow(
                    dynamicValuesHost,
                    34
                )

            row.LayoutOrder =
                index

            local label =
                Instance.new(
                    "TextLabel"
                )

            label.Size =
                UDim2.new(
                    0.48,
                    -5,
                    1,
                    0
                )

            label.Position =
                UDim2.fromOffset(
                    8,
                    0
                )

            label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            label.Text = info.Label
            label.TextTruncate =
                Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

            label.TextColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    225,
                    230,
                    240
                )

            label.TextSize = 8
            label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium

            label.TextXAlignment =
                Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

            label.ZIndex = 24
            label.Parent = row

            local box =
                Instance.new(
                    "TextBox"
                )

            box.Size =
                UDim2.new(
                    0.31,
                    -4,
                    0,
                    25
                )

            box.Position =
                UDim2.new(
                    0.50,
                    0,
                    0.5,
                    -12
                )

            box.BackgroundColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    9,
                    12,
                    18
                )

            box.BackgroundTransparency =
                0.10

            box.BorderSizePixel = 0
            box.ClearTextOnFocus = false

            box.TextColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    250,
                    252,
                    255
                )

            box.Text =
                tostring(
                    object.Value
                )

            box.TextSize = 8
            box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            box.ZIndex = 24
            box.Parent = row

            AddCorner(
                box,
                6
            )

            local apply =
                Instance.new(
                    "TextButton"
                )

            apply.Size =
                UDim2.new(
                    0.18,
                    -5,
                    0,
                    25
                )

            apply.Position =
                UDim2.new(
                    0.82,
                    0,
                    0.5,
                    -12
                )

            apply.BackgroundColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    15,
                    22,
                    31
                )

            apply.BackgroundTransparency =
                0.08

            apply.BorderSizePixel = 0
            apply.Text = "应用"
            apply.TextSize = 8
            apply.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            apply.AutoButtonColor = false
            apply.ZIndex = 24
            apply.Parent = row

            AddCorner(
                apply,
                6
            )

            AddDBEnchantedBorder(
                apply,
                0.62,
                true
            )

            StylePlayerPanelButton(
                apply,
                false
            )

            apply.Activated:Connect(function()
                if not object.Parent then
                    return
                end

                pcall(function()
                    if object:IsA(
                        "BoolValue"
                    ) then
                        object.Value =
                            string.lower(
                                box.Text
                            ) == "true"
                    elseif object:IsA(
                        "IntValue"
                    ) then
                        object.Value =
                            math.floor(
                                safeNumber(
                                    box.Text
                                )
                                or object.Value
                            )
                    elseif object:IsA(
                        "NumberValue"
                    ) then
                        object.Value =
                            safeNumber(
                                box.Text
                            )
                            or object.Value
                    else
                        object.Value =
                            box.Text
                    end
                end)

                box.Text =
                    tostring(
                        object.Value
                    )
            end)
        end
    end

    createAction(

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 初始快照 / 恢复
    --------------------------------------------------------
    local restoreSection =
        createSection(
            "恢复与刷新"
        )

    local function captureSnapshot()
        local player,
            character,
            humanoid,
            root,
            camera =
            getTargets()

        if not humanoid then
            return
        end

        snapshot = {
            WalkSpeed =
                humanoid.WalkSpeed,

            JumpPower =
                humanoid.JumpPower,

            JumpHeight =
                humanoid.JumpHeight,

            HipHeight =
                humanoid.HipHeight,

            MaxSlopeAngle =
                humanoid.MaxSlopeAngle,

            Health =
                humanoid.Health,

            MaxHealth =
                humanoid.MaxHealth,

            AutoRotate =
                humanoid.AutoRotate,

            UseJumpPower =
                humanoid.UseJumpPower,

            PlatformStand =
                humanoid.PlatformStand,

            Gravity =
                workspace.Gravity,

            FOV =
                camera
                and camera.FieldOfView,

            MinZoom =
                player.CameraMinZoomDistance,

            MaxZoom =
                player.CameraMaxZoomDistance,

            CameraOffset =
                humanoid.CameraOffset,

            RootAnchored =
                root
                and root.Anchored,

            RootMassless =
                root
                and root.Massless,

            Scales = {}
        }

        for _,
            info in ipairs(
                scaleNames
            ) do
            local value =
                humanoid:FindFirstChild(
                    info[2]
                )

            if value
            and value:IsA(
                "NumberValue"
            ) then
                snapshot.Scales[
                    info[2]
                ] =
                    value.Value
            end
        end
    end

    local function restoreSnapshot()
        if not snapshot then
            return
        end

        local player,
            _,
            humanoid,
            root,
            camera =
            getTargets()

        if not humanoid then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            humanoid.WalkSpeed =
                snapshot.WalkSpeed

            humanoid.JumpPower =
                snapshot.JumpPower

            humanoid.JumpHeight =
                snapshot.JumpHeight

            humanoid.HipHeight =
                snapshot.HipHeight

            humanoid.MaxSlopeAngle =
                snapshot.MaxSlopeAngle

            humanoid.MaxHealth =
                snapshot.MaxHealth

            humanoid.Health =
                math.min(
                    snapshot.Health,
                    snapshot.MaxHealth
                )

            humanoid.AutoRotate =
                snapshot.AutoRotate

            humanoid.UseJumpPower =
                snapshot.UseJumpPower

            humanoid.PlatformStand =
                snapshot.PlatformStand

            humanoid.CameraOffset =
                snapshot.CameraOffset

            workspace.Gravity =
                snapshot.Gravity

            if camera
            and snapshot.FOV then
                camera.FieldOfView =
                    snapshot.FOV
            end

            player.CameraMinZoomDistance =
                snapshot.MinZoom

            player.CameraMaxZoomDistance =
                snapshot.MaxZoom

            if root then
                root.Anchored =
                    snapshot.RootAnchored

                root.Massless =
                    snapshot.RootMassless
            end

            for name,
                value in pairs(
                    snapshot.Scales
                ) do
                local scale =
                    humanoid:FindFirstChild(
                        name
                    )

                if scale
                and scale:IsA(
                    "NumberValue"
                ) then
                    scale.Value =
                        value
                end
            end
        end)

        notify(
            "已恢复打开玩家面板时保存的主要数据"
        )
    end

    createAction(
        restoreSection,
        "保存当前数据为恢复点",
        function()
            captureSnapshot()
            notify(
                "已保存当前恢复点"
            )
        end
    )

    createAction(
        restoreSection,
        "恢复保存的数据",
        restoreSnapshot
    )

    local warning =
        Instance.new(
            "TextLabel"
        )

    warning.Size =
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            0,
            0,
            48
        )

    warning.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    warning.Text =
        "说明：用户编号、账号年龄等只读信息只展示；血量、移动速度、排行榜数值等若由游戏服务器控制，修改后可能被服务器重新写回。"

    warning.TextWrapped = true

    warning.TextColor3 =
        Color3.fromRGB(
            255,
            222,
            150
        )

    warning.TextSize = 8
    warning.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium

    warning.TextXAlignment =
        Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    warning.TextYAlignment =
        Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

    warning.ZIndex = 23
    warning.Parent = restoreSection

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 刷新
    --------------------------------------------------------
    function controller.Refresh()
        for _,
            callback in ipairs(
                refreshers
            ) do
            pcall(
                callback
            )
        end

        pcall(
            refreshValueRows
        )
    end

    function controller.Show()
        panel.Visible = true

        for _, obj in ipairs(panel:GetDescendants()) do
            if (
                obj:IsA("Frame")
                or obj:IsA("TextButton")
                or obj:IsA("TextBox")
                or obj:IsA("ScrollingFrame")
            )
            and obj.BackgroundTransparency < 0.98 then
                local c = obj.BackgroundColor3
                local luminance =
                    c.R * 0.299
                    + c.G * 0.587
                    + c.B * 0.114

                if luminance < 0.48 then
                    obj.BackgroundColor3 =
                        Color3.fromRGB(
                            255,
                            255,
                            255
                        )

                    obj.BackgroundTransparency =
                        math.max(
                            obj.BackgroundTransparency,
                            0.82
                        )
                end
            end

            if obj:IsA("UIStroke")
            and obj.Name ~= "DB_RainbowMain"
             then
                obj.Color =
                    Color3.fromRGB(
                        255,
                        255,
                        255
                    )
            end
        end

        panel.BackgroundColor3 =
            Color3.fromRGB(
                255,
                255,
                255
            )

        panel.BackgroundTransparency =
            0.82

        if not snapshot then
            captureSnapshot()
        end

        controller.Refresh()
    end

    function controller.Hide()
        panel.Visible = false
    end

    controller.Frame = panel

    refreshButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        controller.Refresh()
    end)

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.delay(
            0.60,
            function()
                if panel.Visible then
                    snapshot = nil
                    controller.Show()
                end
            end
        )
    end)

    return controller
end

--========================================================--
--  高科技角色预览：
--  头像 ⇄ 3D立体人物
--  类Minecraft背包人物：自动同步真实角色动作与正面转向
--========================================================--

local function CreatePlayer3DPreview()
    local PreviewRunService =
        game:GetService(
            "RunService"
        )

    local previewState = {
        Enabled = false,

        SourceCharacter = nil,
        SourceRoot = nil,

        CloneCharacter = nil,
        CloneRoot = nil,

        PartPairs = {},

        Center = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0),
        Distance = 7,

        -- 记录开启3D时真实人物的朝向。
        -- 之后只在正面左右90度范围内同步。
        BaseSourceYaw = 0,
        DisplayYaw = 0
    }

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 轻量蓝白附魔切换按钮
    --------------------------------------------------------
    local switchButton =
        Instance.new(
            "TextButton"
        )

    switchButton.Name =
        "Player3DSwitch"

    switchButton.Position =
        UDim2.fromOffset(
            3,
            28
        )

    switchButton.Size =
        UDim2.fromOffset(
            24,
            24
        )

    switchButton.BackgroundColor3 =
        Color3.fromRGB(
            12,
            22,
            34
        )

    switchButton.BackgroundTransparency =
        0.12

    switchButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    switchButton.AutoButtonColor = false

    -- 双向切换符号，含义与参考图一致。
    switchButton.Text = "⇅"

    switchButton.TextSize = 14
    switchButton.Font =
        Enum.Font.GothamBlack

    switchButton.ZIndex = 45
    switchButton.Parent =
        PlayerInfoCard

    AddCorner(
        switchButton,
        9
    )

    AddDBEnchantedBorder(
        switchButton,
        0.72,
        true
    )

    AddDBEnchantedText(
        switchButton,
        false
    )

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3D长方形预览框：
    -- 几乎占满整个玩家信息卡，仅保留很小边距。
    --------------------------------------------------------
    local viewport =
        Instance.new(
            "ViewportFrame"
        )

    viewport.Name =
        "Player3DViewport"

    -- 3D只替换“原大头像”的左侧区域。
    -- 三行玩家文字永远保留在右边。
    -- 这个区域对应用户标出的红框：
    -- 上：玩家信息标题下方
    -- 左：卡片左边
    -- 右：三行文字左边
    -- 下：好友框上沿
    viewport.Position =
        UDim2.fromOffset(
            5,
            29
        )

    viewport.Size =
        UDim2.fromOffset(
            94,
            94
        )

    viewport.BackgroundColor3 =
        Color3.fromRGB(
            7,
            12,
            20
        )

    viewport.BackgroundTransparency =
        0.035

    viewport.BorderSizePixel = 0
    viewport.Active = false

    viewport.Ambient =
        Color3.fromRGB(
            180,
            190,
            215
        )

    viewport.LightColor =
        Color3.fromRGB(
            255,
            255,
            255
        )

    viewport.LightDirection =
        Vector3.new(
            -0.55,
            -0.85,
            -0.65
        )

    viewport.ImageColor3 =
        Color3.fromRGB(
            255,
            255,
            255
        )

    viewport.ImageTransparency = 0

    viewport.Visible = false
    viewport.ZIndex = 34
    viewport.Parent =
        PlayerInfoCard

    AddCorner(
        viewport,
        10
    )

    AddDBEnchantedBorder(
        viewport,
        0.72,
        true
    )

    local world =
        Instance.new(
            "WorldModel"
        )

    world.Name =
        "DB_PlayerPreviewWorld"

    world.Parent =
        viewport

    local camera =
        Instance.new(
            "Camera"
        )

    camera.Name =
        "DB_PlayerPreviewCamera"

    camera.FieldOfView = 30
    camera.Parent =
        viewport

    viewport.CurrentCamera =
        camera

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 工具：建立稳定路径，配对实时角色和预览角色的BasePart
    --------------------------------------------------------
    local function GetRelativePath(
        object,
        root
    )
        local names = {}
        local current = object

        while current
        and current ~= root do
            table.insert(
                names,
                1,
                current.Name
            )

            current =
                current.Parent
        end

        return table.concat(
            names,
            "/"
        )
    end

    local function ClearPreviewCharacter()
        previewState.PartPairs = {}
        previewState.SourceCharacter = nil
        previewState.SourceRoot = nil
        previewState.CloneRoot = nil

        if previewState.CloneCharacter then
            pcall(function()
                previewState.CloneCharacter:Destroy()
            end)

            previewState.CloneCharacter = nil
        end

        for _, child in ipairs(
            world:GetChildren()
        ) do
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local function UpdatePreviewCamera()
        -- 镜头固定在人物正面。
        -- 人物本身根据真实角色转向进行有限度旋转。
        camera.CFrame =
            CFrame.lookAt(
                previewState.Center
                + Vector3.new(
                    0,
                    0,
                    previewState.Distance
                ),
                previewState.Center
            )
    end

    local function GetYawFromCFrame(cf)
        local look =
            cf.LookVector

        return math.atan2(
            -look.X,
            -look.Z
        )
    end

    local function WrapAngle(angle)
        return math.atan2(
            math.sin(angle),
            math.cos(angle)
        )
    end


    local function BuildPreviewCharacter()
        ClearPreviewCharacter()

        local character =
            LocalPlayer.Character

        if not character then
            return
        end

        local sourceRoot =
            character:FindFirstChild(
                "HumanoidRootPart"
            )

        if not sourceRoot then
            return
        end

        local oldArchivable =
            character.Archivable

        character.Archivable = true

        local ok, clone =
            pcall(function()
                return character:Clone()
            end)

        character.Archivable =
            oldArchivable

        if not ok
        or not clone then
            return
        end

        clone.Name =
            "DB_Player3DClone"

        ----------------------------------------------------
        -- 不显示Tool / 道具，也不让任何脚本在Viewport里运行
        ----------------------------------------------------
        for _, object in ipairs(
            clone:GetDescendants()
        ) do
            if object:IsA("Tool")
            or object:IsA("Script")
            or object:IsA("LocalScript")
            or object:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                object:Destroy()

            elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
                object.Anchored = true
                object.CanCollide = false
                object.CanQuery = false
                object.CanTouch = false

                object.CastShadow = false
            end
        end

        local cloneHumanoid =
            clone:FindFirstChildOfClass(
                "Humanoid"
            )

        if cloneHumanoid then
            pcall(function()
                cloneHumanoid.DisplayDistanceType =
                    Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
            end)
        end

        clone.Parent =
            world

        local cloneRoot =
            clone:FindFirstChild(
                "HumanoidRootPart"
            )

        if not cloneRoot then
            clone:Destroy()
            return
        end

        ----------------------------------------------------
        -- 使用路径配对身体部件。
        -- 预览每帧复制真实人物部件相对Root的CFrame，
        -- 所以真实玩家正在跑/跳/做动作时预览会同步。
        ----------------------------------------------------
        local cloneParts = {}

        for _, part in ipairs(
            clone:GetDescendants()
        ) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                cloneParts[
                    GetRelativePath(
                        part,
                        clone
                    )
                ] = part
            end
        end

        local pairsList = {}

        for _, sourcePart in ipairs(
            character:GetDescendants()
        ) do
            if sourcePart:IsA("BasePart") then
                -- Tool里的部件不进入3D预览
                local isToolPart =
                    sourcePart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass(
                        "Tool"
                    )
                    ~= nil

                if not isToolPart then
                    local key =
                        GetRelativePath(
                            sourcePart,
                            character
                        )

                    local clonePart =
                        cloneParts[key]

                    if clonePart then
                        pairsList[
                            #pairsList + 1
                        ] = {
                            Source =
                                sourcePart,

                            Clone =
                                clonePart
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        previewState.SourceCharacter =
            character

        previewState.SourceRoot =
            sourceRoot

        previewState.BaseSourceYaw =
            GetYawFromCFrame(
                sourceRoot.CFrame
            )

        -- Viewport摄像机位于人物 +Z 方向。
        -- 角色本地正面通常朝 -Z，因此基础补180°，
        -- 保证3D人物默认正面对着我们，而不是背对着我们。
        previewState.DisplayYaw =
            math.rad(180)

        previewState.CloneCharacter =
            clone

        previewState.CloneRoot =
            cloneRoot

        previewState.PartPairs =
            pairsList

        ----------------------------------------------------
        -- 先同步一次姿态，再按BoundingBox自动计算镜头距离
        ----------------------------------------------------
        for _, pair in ipairs(
            previewState.PartPairs
        ) do
            if pair.Source.Parent
            and pair.Clone.Parent then
                pair.Clone.CFrame =
                    CFrame.Angles(
                        0,
                        previewState.DisplayYaw,
                        0
                    )
                    * sourceRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(
                        pair.Source.CFrame
                    )
            end
        end

        local boxCF, boxSize =
            clone:GetBoundingBox()

        previewState.Center =
            boxCF.Position

        ----------------------------------------------------
        -- 根据真实模型包围盒自动计算镜头距离。
        -- 目标：
        -- 1. 头发最顶端完整显示
        -- 2. 脚底完整显示
        -- 3. 上下左右再多留一点安全边距
        --
        -- 不再使用固定 largest * 倍率，因此不同身高、
        -- 不同头发/配饰的角色都能更稳定地完整进入框内。
        ----------------------------------------------------
        local halfFov =
            math.rad(
                camera.FieldOfView
                * 0.5
            )

        local tanHalfFov =
            math.max(
                0.01,
                math.tan(
                    halfFov
                )
            )

        local fitY =
            (
                boxSize.Y
                * 0.5
            )
            / tanHalfFov

        -- 当前Viewport接近正方形，
        -- 水平也用同一FOV估算，再取更大的一个。
        local fitX =
            (
                boxSize.X
                * 0.5
            )
            / tanHalfFov

        local depthAllowance =
            boxSize.Z
            * 0.5

        local extraMargin =
            0.42

        previewState.Distance =
            math.max(
                4.8,
                math.max(
                    fitX,
                    fitY
                )
                + depthAllowance
                + extraMargin
            )

        previewState.Yaw = 0
        previewState.Pitch = 0

        UpdatePreviewCamera()
    end

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 普通头像模式 ⇄ 3D模式
    --------------------------------------------------------
    local function SetPreviewEnabled(
        enabled
    )
        previewState.Enabled =
            enabled == true

        -- 只切换左侧头像区域：
        -- 2D头像 ⇄ 3D人物。
        -- 玩家名字 / 账号年龄 / 用户名 / 好友区全部始终保留。
        PlayerAvatar.Visible =
            not previewState.Enabled

        PlayerNameLabel.Visible = true
        PlayerAgeLabel.Visible = true
        PlayerUsernameLabel.Visible = true
        FriendBox.Visible = true

        viewport.Visible =
            previewState.Enabled

        if previewState.Enabled then
            BuildPreviewCharacter()
        end
    end

    switchButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        SetPreviewEnabled(
            not previewState.Enabled
        )
    end)

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 每帧复制真实人物当前姿态。
    -- 这是动作同步的核心，不重新播放动画，也不复制Tool。
    --------------------------------------------------------
    local renderConnection =
        PreviewRunService.RenderStepped:Connect(
            function()
                if not previewState.Enabled then
                    return
                end

                local sourceRoot =
                    previewState.SourceRoot

                local clone =
                    previewState.CloneCharacter

                if not sourceRoot
                or not sourceRoot.Parent
                or not clone
                or not clone.Parent then
                    BuildPreviewCharacter()
                    return
                end

                ------------------------------------------------
                -- 同步真实人物转向，但绝不显示背身。
                --
                -- 相对开启3D时的正面方向：
                --   左最大 -90°
                --   右最大 +90°
                -- 总可见转动范围 = 180°
                --
                -- 如果真实人物已经转到背面区域，
                -- 预览人物就停在最后一个侧面角度，
                -- 等真实人物重新回到正面半区后再继续同步。
                ------------------------------------------------
                local currentYaw =
                    GetYawFromCFrame(
                        sourceRoot.CFrame
                    )

                local rawYaw =
                    WrapAngle(
                        currentYaw
                        - previewState.BaseSourceYaw
                    )

                local maxFrontYaw =
                    math.rad(90)

                if math.abs(rawYaw)
                <= maxFrontYaw then
                    -- 180° 是“正面对镜头”的基础朝向。
                    -- 在这个基础上只允许左右各90°。
                    previewState.DisplayYaw =
                        math.rad(180)
                        + rawYaw
                end

                local previewRotation =
                    CFrame.Angles(
                        0,
                        previewState.DisplayYaw,
                        0
                    )

                ------------------------------------------------
                -- 动作仍然逐帧同步：
                -- 跑、跳、挥手等姿态全部跟真实人物一致。
                -- Tool仍然不会进入预览。
                ------------------------------------------------
                for _, pair in ipairs(
                    previewState.PartPairs
                ) do
                    local sourcePart =
                        pair.Source

                    local clonePart =
                        pair.Clone

                    if sourcePart
                    and sourcePart.Parent
                    and clonePart
                    and clonePart.Parent then
                        clonePart.CFrame =
                            previewRotation
                            * sourceRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(
                                sourcePart.CFrame
                            )
                    end
                end
            end
        )

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 重生时自动重建3D人物
    --------------------------------------------------------
    local characterConnection =
        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(
            function()
                if previewState.Enabled then
                    task.delay(
                        0.45,
                        BuildPreviewCharacter
                    )
                end
            end
        )

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- DB界面被销毁时清理连接
    --------------------------------------------------------
    PlayerInfoCard.AncestryChanged:Connect(
        function(_, parent)
            if parent ~= nil then
                return
            end

            pcall(function()
                renderConnection:Disconnect()
            end)

            pcall(function()
                characterConnection:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
    )

    return {
        Button = switchButton,
        Viewport = viewport,
        SetEnabled = SetPreviewEnabled,
        Refresh = BuildPreviewCharacter
    }
end

local function GetUserHeadshot(userId)
    local ok, content =
        pcall(function()
            local image =
                Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(
                    userId,
                    Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,
                    Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150
                )

            return image
        end)

    if ok then
        return content
    end

    return ""
end

    local startTimeLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    startTimeLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 3)
    startTimeLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 13)
    startTimeLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    startTimeLabel.Text = "0:00"
    startTimeLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 153, 163)
    startTimeLabel.TextSize = 7
    startTimeLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    startTimeLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    startTimeLabel.ZIndex = 25
    startTimeLabel.Parent = chart

    local midTimeLabel = startTimeLabel:Clone()
    midTimeLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    midTimeLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 3)
    midTimeLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    midTimeLabel.Parent = chart

    local endTimeLabel = startTimeLabel:Clone()
    endTimeLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
    endTimeLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -3, 1, 3)
    endTimeLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    endTimeLabel.Parent = chart

    -- 每0.5秒无条件记录一次FPS，不再设置“达到某个波动才记录”的门槛。
    local SAMPLE_INTERVAL = 0.5

    -- 0.75秒滚动帧时间只用于计算当前FPS，避免计时器自身抖动。
    local SMOOTH_WINDOW = 0.75

    -- 图表固定只显示最近1分钟。
    local HISTORY_WINDOW = 60

    -- 0.5秒一个样本：1分钟约120个点，预留1个端点。
    local MAX_HISTORY = 121
    local MAX_DRAW_POINTS = 121

    -- 当前Roblox环境按60FPS上限显示。
    -- 防止采样窗口边界产生60.5/61.2之类的虚高值。
    local FPS_CAP = 60
    local FPS_AXIS_MAX = 120

    local state = {
        SessionStart = time(),
        SampleClock = 0,
        FrameTimes = {},
        Samples = {},
        SmoothedFPS = nil,
        SmoothedPing = nil,
        Segments = {},
        LastStatsUpdate = 0
    }

    -- 曲线层直接放在图表内部。
    -- 这样坐标、滚动、缩放全部跟随GUI，不再出现Drawing屏幕坐标偏移。
    local lineLayer = Instance.new("Frame")
    lineLayer.Name = "FPSLineLayer"
    lineLayer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    lineLayer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lineLayer.BorderSizePixel = 0
    lineLayer.ClipsDescendants = true
    lineLayer.ZIndex = 29
    lineLayer.Parent = chart

    state.UseDrawing = false

    for i = 1, MAX_DRAW_POINTS - 1 do
        local line =
            Instance.new("Frame")

        line.Name =
            "FPSLine_"
            .. tostring(i)

        -- 1px视觉线条，围绕两点中点旋转。
        -- 不再使用早期那种粗矩形段。
        line.AnchorPoint =
            Vector2.new(
                0.5,
                0.5
            )

        line.Size =
            UDim2.fromOffset(
                0,
                1
            )

        line.BackgroundColor3 =
            Color3.fromRGB(
                176,
                178,
                183
            )

        line.BackgroundTransparency =
            0.06

        line.BorderSizePixel = 0
        line.Visible = false
        line.ZIndex = 30
        line.Parent = lineLayer

        state.Segments[i] =
            line
    end

    local function hideAllGraphLines()
        for _, line in ipairs(
            state.Segments
        ) do
            if line
            and line.Parent then
                line.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end

    local function formatTime(seconds)
        seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds or 0))
        local minutes = math.floor(seconds / 60)
        local remain = seconds % 60
        return tostring(minutes) .. ":" .. string.format("%02d", remain)
    end

    local function getWindowFPS(now)
        local cutoff = now - SMOOTH_WINDOW
        while #state.FrameTimes > 0 and state.FrameTimes[1].Time < cutoff do
            table.remove(state.FrameTimes, 1)
        end

        local count = #state.FrameTimes
        if count < 2 then
            return nil
        end

        local totalDt = 0
        for _, frame in ipairs(state.FrameTimes) do
            totalDt = totalDt + frame.Dt
        end

        if totalDt <= 0 then
            return nil
        end

        return math.clamp(count / totalDt, 1, 240)
    end

    local function makePlotSamples()
        local source = state.Samples
        local count = #source
        local result = {}

        -- 一分钟数据量本身就很小，全部原样绘制，不做平均、不做桶压缩。
        local firstIndex =
            math.max(
                1,
                count - MAX_DRAW_POINTS + 1
            )

        for i = firstIndex, count do
            result[#result + 1] = source[i]
        end

        return result
    end

    local function updateStats()
        local samples = state.Samples
        local count = #samples
        if count == 0 then return end

        local values = {}
        local sum = 0
        local maxValue = -math.huge
        local minValue = math.huge

        for i, sample in ipairs(samples) do
            local value = sample.FPS
            values[i] = value
            sum = sum + value
            maxValue = math.max(maxValue, value)
            minValue = math.min(minValue, value)
        end

        local avg = sum / count
        local variance = 0
        for _, value in ipairs(values) do
            local d = value - avg
            variance = variance + d * d
        end

        local deviation = math.sqrt(variance / math.max(1, count))
        local jitter = avg > 0 and (deviation / avg * 100) or 0
        table.sort(values)

        local lowCount = math.max(1, math.floor(count * 0.05 + 0.5))
        local lowSum = 0
        for i = 1, lowCount do
            lowSum = lowSum + values[i]
        end
        local low5 = lowSum / lowCount

        statValues["MAX"].Text = string.format("%.1f", maxValue)
        statValues["MIN"].Text = string.format("%.1f", minValue)
        statValues["AVG"].Text = string.format("%.1f", avg)
        statValues["JITTER"].Text = string.format("%.1f%%", jitter)
        statValues["5% LOW"].Text = string.format("%.1f", low5)
    end

    local function refreshGraph()
        local plot =
            makePlotSamples()

        local width =
            math.max(
                1,
                lineLayer.AbsoluteSize.X
            )

        local height =
            math.max(
                1,
                lineLayer.AbsoluteSize.Y
            )

        local elapsed =
            math.max(
                0,
                time()
                - state.SessionStart
            )

        local rightTime =
            elapsed

        local leftTime =
            math.max(
                0,
                rightTime
                - HISTORY_WINDOW
            )

        local span =
            math.max(
                1,
                rightTime
                - leftTime
            )

        for i, line in ipairs(
            state.Segments
        ) do
            local a =
                plot[i]

            local b =
                plot[i + 1]

            if line
            and a
            and b
            and HomePanel.Visible
            and Panel.Visible then
                local x1 =
                    math.clamp(
                        (
                            a.Time
                            - leftTime
                        )
                        / span,
                        0,
                        1
                    )
                    * width

                local x2 =
                    math.clamp(
                        (
                            b.Time
                            - leftTime
                        )
                        / span,
                        0,
                        1
                    )
                    * width

                local y1 =
                    (
                        1
                        - math.clamp(
                            a.FPS
                            / FPS_AXIS_MAX,
                            0,
                            1
                        )
                    )
                    * height

                local y2 =
                    (
                        1
                        - math.clamp(
                            b.FPS
                            / FPS_AXIS_MAX,
                            0,
                            1
                        )
                    )
                    * height

                local dx =
                    x2 - x1

                local dy =
                    y2 - y1

                local length =
                    math.sqrt(
                        dx * dx
                        + dy * dy
                    )

                line.Position =
                    UDim2.fromOffset(
                        (
                            x1
                            + x2
                        )
                        * 0.5,
                        (
                            y1
                            + y2
                        )
                        * 0.5
                    )

                line.Size =
                    UDim2.fromOffset(
                        math.max(
                            0.5,
                            length
                        ),
                        1
                    )

                line.Rotation =
                    math.deg(
                        math.atan2(
                            dy,
                            dx
                        )
                    )

                line.Visible = true
            elseif line then
                line.Visible = false
            end
        end

        startTimeLabel.Text =
            formatTime(
                leftTime
            )

        midTimeLabel.Text =
            formatTime(
                leftTime
                + span
                * 0.5
            )

        endTimeLabel.Text =
            formatTime(
                rightTime
            )
    end

    local function takeSample()
        local now = time()
        local rawFPS =
            getWindowFPS(now)

        if not rawFPS then
            return
        end

        -- 当前环境60FPS封顶。
        -- 采样误差造成的60.3/61.2统一校准回60。
        rawFPS =
            math.clamp(
                rawFPS,
                1,
                FPS_CAP
            )

        -- 每0.5秒都记录，不按波动幅度筛选。
        state.SmoothedFPS =
            rawFPS


        local pingOk, ping = pcall(function()
            return LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing()
        end)

        if pingOk and type(ping) == "number" then
            local pingMS = ping * 1000
            if not state.SmoothedPing then
                state.SmoothedPing = pingMS
            else
                state.SmoothedPing = state.SmoothedPing + (pingMS - state.SmoothedPing) * 0.30
            end
        end

        local elapsed = now - state.SessionStart
        table.insert(state.Samples, {FPS = state.SmoothedFPS, Time = elapsed})

        local cutoff =
            math.max(
                0,
                elapsed - HISTORY_WINDOW
            )

        while #state.Samples > 0
        and state.Samples[1].Time < cutoff do
            table.remove(state.Samples, 1)
        end

        while #state.Samples > MAX_HISTORY do
            table.remove(state.Samples, 1)
        end


        local displayFPS = math.floor(state.SmoothedFPS + 0.5)
        local displayPing = math.floor((state.SmoothedPing or 0) + 0.5)
        liveLabel.Text = "FPS：" .. tostring(displayFPS) .. "    Ping：" .. tostring(displayPing) .. " ms"

        local runningAverage = 0

        if #state.Samples > 0 then
            local sumFPS = 0

            for _, sample in ipairs(state.Samples) do
                sumFPS = sumFPS + sample.FPS
            end

            runningAverage = sumFPS / #state.Samples
        end

        avgTopLabel.Text =
            "AVG："
            .. string.format("%.1f", runningAverage)

        floatingText.Text = "FPS " .. tostring(displayFPS)
        refreshGraph()

        if now - state.LastStatsUpdate >= 1.5 then
            state.LastStatsUpdate = now
            updateStats()
        end
    end

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        local now =
            time()

        table.insert(
            state.FrameTimes,
            {
                Time = now,
                Dt = dt
            }
        )

        state.SampleClock =
            state.SampleClock
            + dt

        while state.SampleClock
        >= SAMPLE_INTERVAL do
            state.SampleClock =
                state.SampleClock
                - SAMPLE_INTERVAL

            takeSample()
        end
    end)

    chart:GetPropertyChangedSignal(
        "AbsoluteSize"
    ):Connect(
        refreshGraph
    )

    lineLayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal(
        "AbsoluteSize"
    ):Connect(
        refreshGraph
    )

    HomePanel:GetPropertyChangedSignal(
        "Visible"
    ):Connect(function()
        if HomePanel.Visible then
            refreshGraph()
        else
            hideAllGraphLines()
        end
    end)

    Panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal(
        "Visible"
    ):Connect(function()
        if Panel.Visible then
            refreshGraph()
        else
            hideAllGraphLines()
        end
    end)


    return {
        Card = card,
        Refresh = refreshGraph,
        SetFloatingVisible = setFloatingEnabled,
        Floating = floatingFPS
    }
end
