local function CreateServerPlayersScroller(
    card
)
    local scroll =
        Instance.new(
            "ScrollingFrame"
        )

    scroll.Name =
        "ServerPlayersScroll"

    scroll.Position =
        UDim2.fromOffset(
            10,
            28
        )

    scroll.Size =
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -18,
            1,
            -34
        )

    scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
    scroll.Active = true
    scroll.ScrollingEnabled = true
    scroll.ClipsDescendants = true

    scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3

    scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 =
        Color3.fromRGB(
            125,
            205,
            255
        )

    scroll.ScrollBarImageTransparency =
        0.18

    scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize =
        Enum.AutomaticSize.None

    scroll.CanvasSize =
        UDim2.new()

    scroll.ScrollingDirection =
        Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y

    scroll.ElasticBehavior =
        Enum.ElasticBehavior.WhenScrollable

    scroll.ZIndex = 24
    scroll.Parent = card

    local content =
        Instance.new(
            "Frame"
        )

    content.Name =
        "ServerPlayersContent"

    content.Size =
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -5,
            0,
            0
        )

    content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    content.BorderSizePixel = 0
    content.ZIndex = 24
    content.Parent = scroll

    local layout =
        Instance.new(
            "UIListLayout"
        )

    layout.FillDirection =
        Enum.FillDirection.Vertical

    layout.SortOrder =
        Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

    layout.Padding =
        UDim.new(
            0,
            3
        )

    layout.Parent = content

    local padding =
        Instance.new(
            "UIPadding"
        )

    padding.PaddingTop =
        UDim.new(
            0,
            2
        )

    padding.PaddingBottom =
        UDim.new(
            0,
            5
        )

    padding.PaddingLeft =
        UDim.new(
            0,
            1
        )

    padding.PaddingRight =
        UDim.new(
            0,
            3
        )

    padding.Parent = content

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 内容高度始终手动写入 CanvasSize。
    -- 不再依赖 AutomaticCanvasSize 在嵌套 ScrollingFrame 中的表现。
    --------------------------------------------------------
    local function SyncCanvas()
        local height =
            layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y
            + 9

        content.Size =
            UDim2.new(
                1,
                -5,
                0,
                height
            )

        scroll.CanvasSize =
            UDim2.fromOffset(
                0,
                height
            )

        local maxY =
            math.max(
                0,
                height
                - scroll.AbsoluteSize.Y
            )

        if scroll.CanvasPosition.Y
        > maxY then
            scroll.CanvasPosition =
                Vector2.new(
                    0,
                    maxY
                )
        end
    end

    layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal(
        "AbsoluteContentSize"
    ):Connect(
        SyncCanvas
    )

    scroll:GetPropertyChangedSignal(
        "AbsoluteSize"
    ):Connect(
        SyncCanvas
    )

    --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 手机嵌套滚动修复：
    -- 在服务器玩家框里滑动时，只滚这个小框，
    -- 不让外层主页把触摸事件抢走。
    --------------------------------------------------------
    local touchState = {
        Active = false,
        Input = nil,
        StartY = 0,
        StartCanvasY = 0
    }

    scroll.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType
        == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            touchState.Active = true
            touchState.Input = input
            touchState.StartY =
                input.Position.Y

            touchState.StartCanvasY =
                scroll.CanvasPosition.Y

            HomeScroll.ScrollingEnabled =
                false
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(
        function(input)
            if not touchState.Active
            or input ~= touchState.Input then
                return
            end

            local deltaY =
                input.Position.Y
                - touchState.StartY

            local contentHeight =
                layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y
                + 9

            local maxY =
                math.max(
                    0,
                    contentHeight
                    - scroll.AbsoluteSize.Y
                )

            local targetY =
                math.clamp(
                    touchState.StartCanvasY
                    - deltaY,
                    0,
                    maxY
                )

            scroll.CanvasPosition =
                Vector2.new(
                    0,
                    targetY
                )
        end
    )

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(
        function(input)
            if touchState.Active
            and input == touchState.Input then
                touchState.Active = false
                touchState.Input = nil

                HomeScroll.ScrollingEnabled =
                    true
            end
        end
    )

    ServerPlayersScroll = scroll
    ServerPlayersContent = content
    ServerPlayersLayout = layout

    task.defer(
        SyncCanvas
    )

    return scroll
end

local function RefreshServerPlayersRows()
    if not ServerPlayersContent
    or not ServerPlayersContent.Parent then
        return
    end

    local players =
        Players:GetPlayers()

    table.sort(
        players,
        function(a, b)
            return string.lower(
                tostring(a.DisplayName)
            )
            < string.lower(
                tostring(b.DisplayName)
            )
        end
    )

    local signatureParts = {}

    for _, player in ipairs(players) do
        signatureParts[
            #signatureParts + 1
        ] =
            tostring(
                player.UserId
            )
    end

    local signature =
        table.concat(
            signatureParts,
            ","
        )

    if signature ==
        ServerPlayersSignature then
        return
    end

    ServerPlayersSignature =
        signature

    for _, child in ipairs(
        ServerPlayersContent:GetChildren()
    ) do
        if child:IsA("TextLabel")
        and child.Name ==
            "ServerPlayerRow" then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    if #players == 0 then
        local empty =
            Instance.new(
                "TextLabel"
            )

        empty.Name =
            "ServerPlayerRow"

        empty.Size =
            UDim2.new(
                1,
                -2,
                0,
                20
            )

        empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        empty.Text = "暂无玩家"

        empty.TextColor3 =
            Color3.fromRGB(
                190,
                194,
                204
            )

        empty.TextSize = 10

        empty.Font =
            Enum.Font.GothamMedium

        empty.TextXAlignment =
            Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

        empty.ZIndex = 25
        empty.Parent =
            ServerPlayersContent

        return
    end

    for index, player in ipairs(players) do
        local row =
            Instance.new(
                "TextLabel"
            )

        row.Name =
            "ServerPlayerRow"

        row.LayoutOrder = index

        row.Size =
            UDim2.new(
                1,
                -2,
                0,
                20
            )

        row.BackgroundColor3 =
            Color3.fromRGB(
                18,
                24,
                33
            )

        row.BackgroundTransparency =
            index % 2 == 0
            and 0.82
            or 0.92

        row.BorderSizePixel = 0

        row.Text =
            tostring(index)
            .. ". "
            .. tostring(
                player.DisplayName
            )
            .. "  (@"
            .. tostring(
                player.Name
            )
            .. ")"

        row.TextColor3 =
            Color3.fromRGB(
                242,
                246,
                252
            )

        row.TextSize = 10

        row.Font =
            Enum.Font.GothamMedium

        row.TextXAlignment =
            Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

        row.TextYAlignment =
            Enum.TextYAlignment.Center

        row.TextTruncate =
            Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

        row.ZIndex = 25
        row.Parent =
            ServerPlayersContent

        AddCorner(
            row,
            5
        )
    end

    task.defer(function()
        if ServerPlayersLayout
        and ServerPlayersScroll then
            local height =
                ServerPlayersLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y
                + 9

            ServerPlayersContent.Size =
                UDim2.new(
                    1,
                    -5,
                    0,
                    height
                )

            ServerPlayersScroll.CanvasSize =
                UDim2.fromOffset(
                    0,
                    height
                )
        end
    end)
end

local function DBGetBeijingTimestamp()
    local unixNow = nil

    local ok, value =
        pcall(function()
            return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        end)

    if ok
    and type(value) == "number"
    and value > 1000000000 then
        unixNow = value
    else
        unixNow = os.time()
    end

    return os.date(
        "!%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
        math.floor(unixNow + 8 * 60 * 60)
    )
end

local function DBBuildProcessText()
    local lines = {
        "DB 主程序  ·  "
        .. DBRuntimeState.MainStatus
    }

    local shown = 0

    for i = #DBRuntimeState.ScriptOrder, 1, -1 do
        local name =
            DBRuntimeState.ScriptOrder[i]

        local info =
            DBRuntimeState.Scripts[name]

        if info then
            table.insert(
                lines,
                name
                .. "  ·  "
                .. tostring(info.Status)
            )

            shown = shown + 1

            if shown >= 4 then
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if shown == 0 then
        table.insert(
            lines,
            "外部脚本  ·  暂无"
        )
    end

    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local function DBBuildPlayersText()
    local players =
        Players:GetPlayers()

    local lines = {}

    for i, p in ipairs(players) do
        table.insert(
            lines,
            tostring(i)
            .. ". "
            .. tostring(p.DisplayName)
            .. " (@"
            .. tostring(p.Name)
            .. ")"
        )
    end

    if #lines == 0 then
        return "暂无玩家"
    end

    return table.concat(
        lines,
        "\n"
    )
end

        end
    end
end

            shade.Parent = card

            AddCorner(

            local label =

            label.Font =

            label.TextXAlignment =
                Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

            label.ZIndex = 22
            label.Parent = card

            card.Activated:Connect(function()
                DBWallpaper.Apply(index)

                -- 不再重新创建页面，只更新当前6张卡片状态。
                -- 这样从根本上杜绝“点一次多一份”的叠加问题。
                for cardIndex = 1, 6 do
                    local item =
                        ListScroll:FindFirstChild(
                            "DB_WallpaperCard_"
                            .. tostring(
                                cardIndex
                            )
                        )

                    if item then
                        local itemStroke =
                            item:FindFirstChildOfClass(
                                "UIStroke"
                            )

                        if itemStroke then
                            local selected =
                                cardIndex == index

                            itemStroke.Thickness =
                                selected
                                and 1.5
                                or 0.8

                            itemStroke.Transparency =
                                selected
                                and 0.18
                                or 0.62
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

    end

        local function MakeSlider(rowName, titlePrefix, ratio, order, onRatio)
            local row = MakeGlassRow(64, order)
            row.Name = rowName
            row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.84

            local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,4)
            title.Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,0,18)
            title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            title.TextSize = 13
            title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            title.ZIndex = 21
            title.Parent = row

            local track = Instance.new("Frame")
            track.Position = UDim2.new(0,14,0,41)
            track.Size = UDim2.new(1,-28,0,6)
            track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.72
            track.BorderSizePixel = 0
            track.Active = true
            track.ZIndex = 22
            track.Parent = row
            AddCorner(track,999)

            local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(ratio,0,1,0)
            fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            fill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.02
            fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
            fill.ZIndex = 23
            fill.Parent = track
            AddCorner(fill,999)

            local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
            knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(ratio,0,0.5,0)
            knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16,16)
            knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            knob.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
            knob.ZIndex = 24
            knob.Active = false
            knob.Parent = track
            AddCorner(knob,999)

            local dragging = false
            local dragInput = nil
            local function ApplyRatio(newRatio)
                newRatio = math.clamp(newRatio,0,1)
                fill.Size = UDim2.new(newRatio,0,1,0)
                knob.Position = UDim2.new(newRatio,0,0.5,0)
                title.Text = titlePrefix .. tostring(onRatio(newRatio))
            end
            ApplyRatio(ratio)

            local function ApplyFromX(x)
                if not track.Parent then return end
                local width = math.max(1, track.AbsoluteSize.X)
                ApplyRatio((x-track.AbsolutePosition.X)/width)
            end
            track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
                dragging = true
                dragInput = input
                ApplyFromX(input.Position.X)
            end)
            UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if not dragging or not track.Parent then return end
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    if input ~= dragInput then return end
                elseif input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                    return
                end
                ApplyFromX(input.Position.X)
            end)
            UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if not dragging then return end
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    if input ~= dragInput then return end
                elseif input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                    return
                end
                dragging = false
                dragInput = nil
            end)
            return row
        end

        MakeSlider("DB_WallpaperTransparencyRow", "壁纸透明度：", DBWallpaper.Transparency, 4, function(ratio)
            DBWallpaper.SetTransparency(ratio)
            return tostring(math.floor(ratio*100+0.5)) .. "%"

        colorPreview.Parent = colorButton
        AddCorner(colorPreview,999)
        local cps = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        cps.Thickness = 1
        cps.Transparency = 0.35
        cps.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        cps.Parent = colorPreview
        colorButton.Parent = ListScroll

        colorButton.Activated:Connect(function()
            local old = RightList:FindFirstChild("DB_WallpaperColorPopup")
            if old then old:Destroy(); return end

            local popup = Instance.new("Frame")
            popup.Name = "DB_WallpaperColorPopup"
            popup.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
            popup.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.52)
            popup.Size = UDim2.new(0.86,0,0,218)
            popup.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8,10,14)
            popup.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
            popup.BorderSizePixel = 0
            popup.ZIndex = 80
            popup.Parent = RightList
            AddCorner(popup,12)
            local ps = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            ps.Thickness = 1
            ps.Transparency = 0.36
            ps.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            ps.Parent = popup

            local pt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            pt.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,6)
            pt.Size = UDim2.new(1,-48,0,28)
            pt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            pt.Text = "壁纸颜色"
            pt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            pt.TextSize = 13
            pt.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            pt.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            pt.ZIndex = 82
            pt.Parent = popup

            local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
            close.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0)
            close.Position = UDim2.new(1,-7,0,6)
            close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28,28)
            close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            close.BorderSizePixel = 0
            close.Text = "×"
            close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            close.TextSize = 20
            close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            close.ZIndex = 83
            close.Parent = popup
            close.Activated:Connect(function() if popup.Parent then popup:Destroy() end end)

            local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
            holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,40)
            holder.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-50)
            holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
            holder.ZIndex = 81
            holder.Parent = popup
            local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
            grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(1/6,-6,0,28)
            grid.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(5,5)
            grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = 6
            grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
            grid.Parent = holder

            local colors = {
                {Name="默认",Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)},
                {Color=Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(95,95,95)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(38,38,42)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(18,18,20)},
                {Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,105,120)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,70,70)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,145,65)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,205,80)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(240,235,90)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(190,240,95)},
                {Color=Color3.fromRGB(90,230,130)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,205,155)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,220,205)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(75,210,245)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(75,165,255)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(90,115,255)},
                {Color=Color3.fromRGB(125,95,255)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(170,90,255)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(220,85,255)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,90,220)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,115,175)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(245,150,185)},
                {Color=Color3.fromRGB(145,105,85)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(185,130,90)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(220,165,115)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,205,165)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(195,220,255)},{Color=Color3.fromRGB(205,190,255)},
            }

            for index, info in ipairs(colors) do
                local swatch = Instance.new("TextButton")
                swatch.BackgroundColor3 = info.Color
                swatch.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                swatch.BorderSizePixel = 0
                swatch.Text = info.Name or ""
                swatch.TextColor3 = (info.Color.R+info.Color.G+info.Color.B)>1.65 and Color3.fromRGB(25,25,28) or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                swatch.TextSize = 8
                swatch.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                swatch.AutoButtonColor = false
                swatch.LayoutOrder = index
                swatch.ZIndex = 82
                swatch.Parent = holder
                AddCorner(swatch,7)
                local ss = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                ss.Thickness = 0.8
                ss.Transparency = 0.45
                ss.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                ss.Parent = swatch
                swatch.Activated:Connect(function()
                    DBWallpaper.SetTintColor(info.Color)
                    colorPreview.BackgroundColor3 = info.Color
                    if popup.Parent then popup:Destroy() end
                end)
            end
        end)

        local brightnessRatio = math.clamp((DBWallpaper.Brightness-0.20)/0.80,0,1)
        MakeSlider("DB_WallpaperBrightnessRow", "壁纸亮度：", brightnessRatio, 6, function(ratio)
            local brightness = 0.20 + ratio*0.80
            DBWallpaper.SetBrightness(brightness)
            return tostring(math.floor(brightness*100+0.5)) .. "%"
        end)

        local borderRow = MakeGlassRow(44,7)
        borderRow.Name = "DB_ButtonBorderRow"
        borderRow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        borderRow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.84

        local borderTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        borderTitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,0)
        borderTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1,-88,1,0)
        borderTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        borderTitle.Text = "按钮边框"
        borderTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        borderTitle.TextSize = 13
        borderTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        borderTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        borderTitle.ZIndex = 21
        borderTitle.Parent = borderRow

        local switch = Instance.new("TextButton")
        switch.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0.5)
        switch.Position = UDim2.new(1,-12,0.5,0)
        switch.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48,24)
        switch.BackgroundColor3 = DBVisualSettings.ButtonBordersEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(205,210,220) or Color3.fromRGB(62,65,72)
        switch.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
        switch.BorderSizePixel = 0
        switch.Text = ""
        switch.AutoButtonColor = false
        switch.ZIndex = 22
        switch.Parent = borderRow
        AddCorner(switch,999)

        local switchKnob = Instance.new("Frame")
        switchKnob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
        switchKnob.Position = DBVisualSettings.ButtonBordersEnabled and UDim2.new(1,-12,0.5,0) or UDim2.new(0,12,0.5,0)
        switchKnob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(19,19)
        switchKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        switchKnob.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        switchKnob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        switchKnob.ZIndex = 23
        switchKnob.Parent = switch
        AddCorner(switchKnob,999)

        switch.Activated:Connect(function()
            local enabled = not DBVisualSettings.ButtonBordersEnabled
            DBVisualSettings.SetButtonBorders(enabled)
            TweenService:Create(switchKnob, TweenInfo.new(0.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = enabled and UDim2.new(1,-12,0.5,0) or UDim2.new(0,12,0.5,0)}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(switch, TweenInfo.new(0.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(205,210,220) or Color3.fromRGB(62,65,72)}):Play()
        end)
    end

end

local function RenderRightList(categoryName)

    HomePanel.Visible = false

    if PlayerControlPanel then
        PlayerControlPanel.Hide()
    end

    local oldDetail =
        RightList:FindFirstChild(
            "DB_ScriptCollectionDetail"
        )

    if oldDetail then
        oldDetail:Destroy()
    end

    ListScroll.Visible = true

    for _, child in ipairs(
        ListScroll:GetChildren()
    ) do
        if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    ListScroll.CanvasPosition =
        Vector2.new(
            0,
            0
        )

    local list = ScriptDatabase[categoryName] or {}
    for _, item in ipairs(list) do
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Name = item.Name

        DBApplyRightFullWidthButton(
            btn,
            32
        )

        btn.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Button
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.24
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        btn.Text = item.Name
        btn.TextColor3 = UI.Text
        btn.TextTransparency = 0
        btn.TextSize = 12
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        btn.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        btn.ZIndex = 15

        StyleLiquidButton(btn, 9, false)

        if categoryName == "DB通用" then
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = DBVisualSettings.ButtonBackground
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = DBVisualSettings.ButtonTransparency
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            btn.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.62
        end

        local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
        pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12)
        pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)
        pad.Parent = btn

        ApplySafeClickEffect(btn, function()
            SafeLoadScript(item)
        end)

        btn.Parent = ListScroll
    end
end

    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    button.ZIndex = 16
    button.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder

    StyleLiquidButton(
        button,
        11,
        false
    )

    local pad =
        Instance.new(
            "UIPadding"
        )

    pad.PaddingLeft =
        UDim.new(

        )

    pad.PaddingRight =
        UDim.new(

        )

    pad.Parent =
        button

    ApplySafeClickEffect(
        button,
        callback
    )

    button.Parent =
        MenuScroll

    return button
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- V86 安全白玻璃后处理
--
-- 不再改底层AddDBEnchantedBorder实现，避免初始化过程中
-- 因旧功能依赖关系导致脚本停止。
-- 等全部UI正常创建完成后，再统一把Panel内部的“特效框”
-- 转为纯白半透明玻璃。
------------------------------------------------------------
local function DBApplySafeWhiteGlassPass()
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        for _, descendant in ipairs(Panel:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant:IsA("UIStroke") then
                local isOuterRainbow = descendant == PanelBorder 
                if not isOuterRainbow then
                    descendant.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    for _, child in ipairs(descendant:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("UIGradient") then child:Destroy() end
                    end
                end
            elseif descendant:IsA("TextLabel") or descendant:IsA("TextButton") then
                for _, child in ipairs(descendant:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("UIGradient") and child.Name == "DB_EnchantTextFlow" then child:Destroy() end
                end
            end
        end
        if ProfileRailDivider then
            ProfileRailDivider.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            ProfileRailDivider.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
        end
        if FunctionRailDivider then
            FunctionRailDivider.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            FunctionRailDivider.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
        end
        for _, descendant in ipairs(Panel:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                descendant.Active = true
                descendant.ScrollingEnabled = true
            end
        end
        DBVisualSettings.ApplyButtonBorders()
    end)
    if not ok then warn("[DB V92] 视觉清理失败：", err) end
end

DBApplySafeWhiteGlassPass()

local function SetPanelPosition(pos)
    local safe =
        ClampPosition(
            pos,
            Vector2.new(
                panelWidth,
                panelHeight
            )
        )

    State.PanelPosition =
        safe

    Panel.Position =
        UDim2.fromOffset(
            safe.X,
            safe.Y
        )
end

local function SetButtonPosition(pos)
    local vp = GetViewport()
    local halfW = FLOATING_WIDTH / 2
    local halfH = FLOATING_HEIGHT / 2

    local new =
        Vector2.new(
            math.clamp(
                pos.X,
                -halfW,
                vp.X + halfW
            ),
            math.clamp(
                pos.Y,
                halfH,
                vp.Y - halfH
            )
        )

    State.ButtonPosition = new
    FloatingButton.Position =
        UDim2.fromOffset(
            new.X,
            new.Y
        )
end

local vp = GetViewport()
SetPanelPosition(Vector2.new(vp.X/2, vp.Y/2))
SetButtonPosition(Vector2.new(vp.X * 0.12, vp.Y * 0.35))

local function Minimize()
    if State.Animating or State.Minimized then return end
    State.Animating = true
    local savedBtnPos = State.ButtonPosition

    FloatingButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(State.PanelPosition.X, State.PanelPosition.Y)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(Panel, TweenInfo.new(ANIMATION_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
        {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BUTTON_SIZE, BUTTON_SIZE)})
    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Wait()

    Panel.Visible = false
    Panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(panelWidth, panelHeight)
    FloatingButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 36)
    FloatingButton.Visible = true
    State.ButtonHidden = false
    State.HideSide = "none"
    SetButtonPosition(savedBtnPos)

    local btnTween = TweenService:Create(FloatingButton, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(FLOATING_WIDTH, FLOATING_HEIGHT)})
    btnTween:Play()

    State.Minimized = true
    State.Animating = false
end

local function Restore()
    if State.Animating or not State.Minimized then return end
    State.Animating = true

    -- V95：隐藏在左右屏幕外时不做自动拉回。

    local vp = GetViewport()
    local centerPos = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    SetPanelPosition(centerPos)

    Panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BUTTON_SIZE, BUTTON_SIZE)
    Panel.Visible = true
    FloatingButton.Visible = false

    local tween = TweenService:Create(Panel, TweenInfo.new(ANIMATION_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(panelWidth, panelHeight)})
    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Wait()

    State.Minimized = false
    State.Animating = false
end

local function EnableDrag(handle, getPos, setPos)
    local dragging = false
    local startInput, startObj, touchInput
    local beganPos = nil

    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if State.Animating then return end
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            startInput = inp.Position
            startObj = getPos()
            beganPos = inp.Position
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then touchInput = inp end
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
        if not dragging then return end
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            if not startInput then return end
            setPos(startObj + (inp.Position - startInput))
        elseif inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and inp == touchInput then
            setPos(startObj + (inp.Position - startInput))
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and inp == touchInput) then
            dragging = false
            startInput = nil; startObj = nil; touchInput = nil
            beganPos = nil
        end
    end)
end

local function InputXY(input)
    return Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
end

local moveDragging = false
local moveStartPointer = nil
local moveStartPanelPos = nil
local moveTouchInput = nil
local moveMagicToken = 0
local movePulseTween = nil
local moveGradientTween = nil

local function SpawnMoveSpark()
    if not MoveBar.Parent then
        return
    end

    local spark = Instance.new("Frame")
    local size = math.random(2, 4)

    spark.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    spark.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
    spark.Position = UDim2.new(
        math.random(8, 92) / 100,
        0,
        0.5,
        math.random(-7, 7)
    )
    spark.BackgroundColor3 =
        (math.random(1, 3) == 1)
        and Color3.fromRGB(205, 177, 255)
        or Color3.fromRGB(210, 242, 255)
    spark.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
    spark.BorderSizePixel = 0
    spark.ZIndex = 73
    spark.Parent = MoveBar
    AddCorner(spark, 999)

    local driftX = math.random(-6, 6)
    local driftY = math.random(-11, -5)

    TweenService:Create(
        spark,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.34,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
            Enum.EasingDirection.Out
        ),
        {
            Position = UDim2.new(
                spark.Position.X.Scale,
                driftX,
                spark.Position.Y.Scale,
                driftY
            ),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size + 2, size + 2)
        }
    ):Play()

    task.delay(0.38, function()
        if spark and spark.Parent then
            spark:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

local function SetMoveBarMagic(active)
    moveMagicToken = moveMagicToken + 1
    local myToken = moveMagicToken

    if movePulseTween then
        movePulseTween:Cancel()
        movePulseTween = nil
    end

    if moveGradientTween then
        moveGradientTween:Cancel()
        moveGradientTween = nil
    end

    if active then
        TweenService:Create(
            MoveBar,
            TweenInfo.new(0.10, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 248),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.02
            }
        ):Play()

        MoveBarGlow.Transparency = 0.05
        MoveBarGlow.Thickness = 1.25

        TweenService:Create(
            MoveBarScale,
            TweenInfo.new(
                0.11,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
                Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            {Scale = 1.018}
        ):Play()

        movePulseTween = TweenService:Create(
            MoveBarGlow,
            TweenInfo.new(
                0.40,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
                Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,
                -1,
                true
            ),
            {
                Transparency = 0.58,
                Thickness = 2.15
            }
        )
        movePulseTween:Play()

        MoveMagicGradient.Rotation = 0
        moveGradientTween = TweenService:Create(
            MoveMagicGradient,
            TweenInfo.new(
                1.05,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
                Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,
                -1,
                false
            ),
            {Rotation = 360}
        )
        moveGradientTween:Play()

        task.spawn(function()
            while moveDragging
            and myToken == moveMagicToken
            and MoveBar.Parent do
                SpawnMoveSpark()
                task.wait(0.13)
            end
        end)
    else
        MoveBarGlow.Transparency = 1
        MoveBarGlow.Thickness = 1.0
        MoveMagicGradient.Rotation = 0

        TweenService:Create(
            MoveBar,
            TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 88, 94),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.20
            }
        ):Play()

        TweenService:Create(
            MoveBarScale,
            TweenInfo.new(
                0.15,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
                Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            {Scale = 1}
        ):Play()
    end
end

local activePanelGesture = nil

local resizing = false
local resizeArmed = false
local resizeStartPointer = nil
local resizeStartSize = nil
local resizeStartPosition = nil
local resizeTouchInput = nil

local resizeMagicToken = 0
local resizePulseTween = nil

local function SpawnResizeSpark()

    if not ResizeArcVisual.Parent then
        return
    end

    local spark = Instance.new("Frame")
    local size = math.random(2, 4)

    spark.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

    spark.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
        math.random(18, 40),
        math.random(17, 39)
    )

    spark.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)

    spark.BackgroundColor3 =
        (math.random(1, 3) == 1)
        and Color3.fromRGB(208, 174, 255)
        or Color3.fromRGB(195, 235, 255)

    spark.BackgroundTransparency = 0.04
    spark.BorderSizePixel = 0
    spark.ZIndex = 94
    spark.Parent = ResizeHandle

    AddCorner(spark, 999)

    local driftX = math.random(-6, 7)
    local driftY = math.random(-8, 4)

    TweenService:Create(
        spark,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.32,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
            Enum.EasingDirection.Out
        ),
        {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
                spark.Position.X.Offset + driftX,
                spark.Position.Y.Offset + driftY
            ),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size + 2, size + 2)
        }
    ):Play()

    task.delay(0.36, function()
        if spark and spark.Parent then
            spark:Destroy()
        end
    end)

end

local function SetResizeMagic(active)

    resizeMagicToken = resizeMagicToken + 1
    local myToken = resizeMagicToken

    if resizePulseTween then
        resizePulseTween:Cancel()
        resizePulseTween = nil
    end

    if active then

        TweenService:Create(
            ResizeArcVisual,
            TweenInfo.new(
                0.10,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
                Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            {
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 250, 255),
                TextTransparency = 0.00,
                TextSize = 53
            }
        ):Play()

        resizePulseTween = TweenService:Create(
            ResizeArcVisual,
            TweenInfo.new(
                0.42,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
                Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,
                -1,
                true
            ),
            {
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 235, 255),
                TextTransparency = 0.18,
                TextSize = 55
            }
        )

        resizePulseTween:Play()

        task.spawn(function()

            while activePanelGesture == "resize"
            and resizeArmed
            and myToken == resizeMagicToken
            and ResizeHandle.Parent do

                SpawnResizeSpark()

                task.wait(0.12)

            end

        end)

    else

        TweenService:Create(
            ResizeArcVisual,
            TweenInfo.new(
                0.14,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
                Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            {
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 156),
                TextTransparency = 0.04,
                TextSize = 50
            }
        ):Play()

    end

end

MoveBarHitArea.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

    if State.Animating
    or State.Minimized
    or activePanelGesture ~= nil then
        return
    end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        activePanelGesture = "move"

        ResizeHandle.Active = false

        resizing = false
        resizeArmed = false
        resizeTouchInput = nil

        moveDragging = true
        moveStartPointer = InputXY(input)
        moveStartPanelPos = State.PanelPosition

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            moveTouchInput = input
        else
            moveTouchInput = nil
        end

        SetMoveBarMagic(true)

    end

end)

ResizeHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

    if State.Animating
    or State.Minimized
    or activePanelGesture ~= nil then
        return
    end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        activePanelGesture = "resize"

        MoveBarHitArea.Active = false

        moveDragging = false
        moveTouchInput = nil

        resizeArmed = true
        resizing = false

        resizeStartPointer = InputXY(input)
        resizeStartSize = Vector2.new(panelWidth, panelHeight)
        resizeStartPosition = State.PanelPosition

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            resizeTouchInput = input
        else
            resizeTouchInput = nil
        end

        SetResizeMagic(true)

    end

end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

    if activePanelGesture == "move"
    and moveDragging then

        local isMouseMove =
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

        local isCorrectTouch =
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            and input == moveTouchInput

        if isMouseMove or isCorrectTouch then

            local pointer = InputXY(input)
            local delta = pointer - moveStartPointer

            SetPanelPosition(
                moveStartPanelPos + delta
            )

        end

        return

    end

    if activePanelGesture == "resize"
    and resizeArmed then

        local isMouseMove =
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

        local isCorrectTouch =
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            and input == resizeTouchInput

        if isMouseMove or isCorrectTouch then

            local pointer = InputXY(input)
            local delta = pointer - resizeStartPointer

            if not resizing then

                if delta.Magnitude < 5 then
                    return
                end

                resizing = true

            end

            local vpNow = GetViewport()

            local maxW = vpNow.X
            local maxH = vpNow.Y

            local minW = math.min(MIN_PANEL_WIDTH, maxW)
            local minH = math.min(MIN_PANEL_HEIGHT, maxH)

            local newW = math.clamp(
                resizeStartSize.X + delta.X,
                minW,
                maxW
            )

            local newH = math.clamp(
                resizeStartSize.Y + delta.Y,
                minH,
                maxH
            )

            local usedDX = newW - resizeStartSize.X
            local usedDY = newH - resizeStartSize.Y

            panelWidth = newW
            panelHeight = newH

            Panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(
                panelWidth,
                panelHeight
            )

            SetPanelPosition(
                resizeStartPosition
                + Vector2.new(
                    usedDX / 2,
                    usedDY / 2
                )
            )

        end

    end

end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

    if activePanelGesture == "move"
    and moveDragging then

        local endedMouse =
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1

        local endedTouch =
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            and input == moveTouchInput

        if endedMouse or endedTouch then

            moveDragging = false
            moveStartPointer = nil
            moveStartPanelPos = nil
            moveTouchInput = nil

            SetMoveBarMagic(false)

            activePanelGesture = nil

            ResizeHandle.Active = true

        end

        return

    end

    if activePanelGesture == "resize"
    and resizeArmed then

        local endedMouse =
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1

        local endedTouch =
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            and input == resizeTouchInput

        if endedMouse or endedTouch then

            resizing = false
            resizeArmed = false

            resizeStartPointer = nil
            resizeStartSize = nil
            resizeStartPosition = nil
            resizeTouchInput = nil

            SetResizeMagic(false)

            activePanelGesture = nil

            MoveBarHitArea.Active = true

        end

    end

end)

task.spawn(function()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then
        return
    end

    camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
        if State.Minimized then
            return
        end

        local vpNow = GetViewport()
        local maxW = vpNow.X
        local maxH = vpNow.Y

        panelWidth = math.clamp(
            panelWidth,
            math.min(MIN_PANEL_WIDTH, maxW),
            maxW
        )

        panelHeight = math.clamp(
            panelHeight,
            math.min(MIN_PANEL_HEIGHT, maxH),
            maxH
        )

        Panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(
            panelWidth,
            panelHeight
        )

        SetPanelPosition(
            State.PanelPosition
            or Vector2.new(vpNow.X / 2, vpNow.Y / 2)
        )
    end)
end)

local btnDragging = false
local btnDragStartPos = nil
local btnDragStartMouse = nil
local btnTouchInput = nil

FloatingDragZone.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType
    ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    and input.UserInputType
    ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        return
    end

    btnDragging = true
    btnDragStartPos = FloatingButton.Position
    btnDragStartMouse = input.Position

    if input.UserInputType
    == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        btnTouchInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not btnDragging then
        return
    end

    if input.UserInputType
    == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        if input ~= btnTouchInput then
            return
        end
    elseif input.UserInputType
    ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        return
    end

    local delta =
        input.Position
        - btnDragStartMouse

    local vp = GetViewport()
    local halfW = FLOATING_WIDTH / 2
    local halfH = FLOATING_HEIGHT / 2

    local newX =
        math.clamp(
            btnDragStartPos.X.Offset
            + delta.X,
            -halfW,
            vp.X + halfW
        )

    local newY =
        math.clamp(
            btnDragStartPos.Y.Offset
            + delta.Y,
            halfH,
            vp.Y - halfH
        )

    FloatingButton.Position =
        UDim2.fromOffset(
            newX,
            newY
        )

    State.ButtonPosition =
        Vector2.new(
            newX,
            newY
        )
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if not btnDragging then
        return
    end

    local ended =
        input.UserInputType
        == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or (
            input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            and input == btnTouchInput
        )

    if not ended then
        return
    end

    btnDragging = false
    btnDragStartPos = nil
    btnDragStartMouse = nil
    btnTouchInput = nil

    -- 松手后完全保持当前位置：
    -- 不吸边、不回弹、不自动弹回屏幕。
    local x =
        FloatingButton.Position.X.Offset

    State.ButtonHidden =
        x <= -FLOATING_WIDTH / 2
        or x >= GetViewport().X + FLOATING_WIDTH / 2

    State.HideSide =
        x < 0
        and "left"
        or (
            x > GetViewport().X
            and "right"
            or "none"
        )
end)

FloatingOpenZone.Activated:Connect(function()
    if State.Minimized and not State.Animating then Restore() end
end)

local __DBExitButton = Header:FindFirstChild("Exit")
if __DBExitButton then
    __DBExitButton.Activated:Connect(DBCloseScript)
end

CloseBtn.Activated:Connect(Minimize)

Panel.Visible = true
FloatingButton.Visible = false
State.Minimized = false
State.ButtonHidden = false
State.HideSide = "none"

-- V86：最终再做一次硬居中。
local __DBReadyViewport =
    GetViewport()

SetPanelPosition(
    Vector2.new(
        __DBReadyViewport.X / 2,
        __DBReadyViewport.Y / 2
    )
)

-- 确保所有滚动区处于可滑状态。
for _,
    descendant in ipairs(
        Panel:GetDescendants()
    ) do
    if descendant:IsA(
        "ScrollingFrame"
    ) then
        descendant.Active = true
        descendant.ScrollingEnabled = true
    end
end

    ShowDBNotification(

        true
    )
end)
